summary: Avalon Peninsula light first lit in 1871: a brick tower encased in iron in 1892, kept by the Costello family for most of a century, with the 1883 Octavia rescue by keeper Philip Keough.

corrections.why: The Lighthouse Directory gives the round tower as 14 m (46 ft). The record's 8.0 m is not supported by any source read here.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Coast Guard's list (current) gives Fl W 10s, which is used. Wikipedia (lead only, not cited) gives Fl W 6s. LF describes a fixed light in 1871 and a group flash from 1921, so the characteristic has changed over time; the current list governs.

notes_for_editor: 1) Tower height: the record says 8.0 m; Rowlett says 14 m (46 ft); Wikipedia (lead only) also says 14 m. Proposed correction only, not applied. 2) Octavia rescue date: LF gives 4 August 1883; the municipal designation gives 14 August 1883. Both are in the story; a human should decide which to show. 3) Sigrid (1903) and Evelyn (1913) appear only in the 2006 municipal designation text; no second source found in this pass, so the story marks them unconfirmed. 4) Dwelling ownership: LF says the Town already owned the keeper's dwelling in 2012; Rowlett says a local development association owns the keeper's house and leases it as a café. Both accounts are in the story. 5) LF describes the tower as built of stone and red brick; the register says firstly brick. The story uses LF's words for the 1871 fabric. 6) Nevill's annual reports (Newfoundland Journal of the House of Assembly) were not read. Every Nevill statement is second-hand through LF. The Canadian Department of Marine corpus does not cover Newfoundland lights before 1949, and no newspaper search was run for Ferryland. 7) Keeper names: Augustan (LF keeper list) vs Augustus (LF text); the story uses Augustan. Wikipedia's keeper dates match LF but Wikipedia is not cited. 8) Gerry Squires is named only in his public role (artist-in-residence, art classes), as LF and the municipal register print it. Lighthouse Picnics' founders are not named. 9) Billy Costello's connection ended in 1970, so he appears only as LF names him in his keeper role. 10) Austin Oke (keeper at Harbour Grace Island) helped install apparatus; he was not stationed here and is not on the roster. 11) Octavia: LF says Keough was an assistant; the register calls him an assistant lightkeeper. Consistent. 12) LF's 1921 characteristic (18 s visible, 4 s eclipse, 4 s visible, 4 s eclipse) is recorded in events only; the story does not use it as current.
